Helper callability and kfunc membership derive from the pinned kernel registration sources; every pinned selftest ID maps onto a record or blocker evidence.
Flipped records cite matrix suites and lanes; unflipped records carry no implementation claim.
The schema and fixture artifact ships at fixed repository paths and through the export bundle layout.
